binding_rule: every source is bound by git blob OID at the named base commit (or by this unit's frozen pre-run hash manifest for new files); nothing is bound by title or memory
convention: saved-input assembly: three categories kept distinct - (1) accepted I017 saved conditional mission/stock records with all their limitations, (2) I032 frozen geometric/material inputs that are declared assumptions, not successful calculations, (3) the new fixed external-reserve construction from the issued I038 design freeze. No I035 output is adopted as capacity, mass, CG, authority or margin data; no formula is copied from exchange.py.

per_pair_commanded_tonnes.order: (service fresh, external reserve fresh, lower fresh, service scoop)

events_command_law.d1_rule: no reserve transfer during D1; both service chambers empty and delivery isolators/positive blank closed and verified before scoop admission; no service liquid delivered as freshwater after the switch; drain residual/switch duration/contamination UNKNOWN unless bounded; no instantaneous unpriced transition
events_command_law.eight_cases: leading pair A/B; rate error +/-0.05; lag 0/2 s; opposite fresh/scoop errors; internal 1:4 reserve:lower split frozen; clamp by source/command target, not tank capacity; unfinished at T is FAIL, never extension
events_command_law.i035_timing_evidence: the eight I035 saved timing FAILs are historical conditional command-law evidence only, not fresh proof for this construction
events_command_law.wrench_rule: liquid at actual fill-dependent centroid; every dry part and pipe inventory included; complete signed forces and moments to common origin and each actual support boundary; opposite x/y stations keep signs; separation is not an origin arm; no fixed liquid centroid for half/full; if frame/receiver stiffness missing retain aggregate six-component wrenches with unresolved individual reactions
events_command_law.reset: moored, earliest inherited 6.5 h; scoop drains separately; service cleaning/verification additional duty; 100 t fresh reloaded; species-consistent helium/air reset; 18.9 MJ PARTIAL listed-subset energy carry; new pumping/cleaning/vent/control energy and timing additional or UNKNOWN
events_command_law.ledger_rule: new quantity ledger from fixed construction and accepted saved inputs; no subtraction from I035 8.991 t; show original conditional I017 duty rows, retained/replaced/removed/new and unresolved C separately; explicit list of absent divider/rings/stiffeners/sump/internal reserve vent/sleeve with NO numeric old saving; qualified retirement ZERO; conditional common-duty comparison only where rowwise established plus a no-retirement bound retaining all previously charged duties; no fully qualified total/margin while required hardware or receiver stock is unpriced; gas/ballonet occupation UNKNOWN; no free lift from vented hardware

steel density 7850 kg/m3 for all new frame/fastener/pipe stock; 5083-class 2660 kg/m3 for tank stock
